_note: Competency question archetype patterns drawn from ontology-engineering practice (PMDco / MaterialsMine / LinkML CQ conventions). The CQ generator aims to produce questions across multiple archetypes per persona. Each persona's question_style in personas.json picks the dominant archetypes naturally; this file lists them explicitly so the generator can spread coverage.

archetypes.purpose: Asks for a single attribute of a named entity. Foundational CQ shape - maps to a single triple.

archetypes.pattern: Which method was used to measure the {property} of {material}?
archetypes.purpose: Connects a material-property pair to the analytical technique. Maps to characterisedBy.
Connects a material to its synthesis route. Maps to producedBy.

archetypes.pattern: Under what {condition_type} was {process} carried out for {material}?
archetypes.purpose: Captures process conditions (T, time, concentration). Maps to performedAt and related condition links.

archetypes.pattern: How does {property} of {material_A} compare with that of {material_B}?
archetypes.purpose: Forces comparative reasoning across two entities in the paper.
Asks about structure-property or process-property relationships. Maps to axioms.

archetypes.pattern: Which {category} entities are reported in this paper?
archetypes.purpose: Bulk listing - useful for ONTO persona (class membership) and CHAR persona (technique inventory).

archetypes.pattern: Which triple (subject, predicate, object) represents the relationship between {entity_A} and {entity_B}?
archetypes.purpose: Direct KG construction CQ. Primary archetype for the ONTO persona.
Captures rationale. Useful for STU (learning) and PHD (research framing) personas.

archetypes.pattern: What limitation or future direction does the paper acknowledge regarding {topic}?
archetypes.purpose: Frontiers CQ. Primary archetype for the PHD persona.

persona_archetype_affinity._note: Soft guidance: each persona should favour these archetypes but is not restricted to them.
